test_title: PYST 7: SSC MTS 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 05 Sept, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, ‘PING’ is coded as '62' and 'HAZE' is coded as ‘68’. What is the code for 'GOAT' in the given code language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : Position value of immediate opposite letters according to English alphabetic series are added.

So,

 
• ‘PING’ is coded as '62'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8b4f4ecb837605e0996dfd9ec19344c60b868691ff1a03ab6ac7aa30764a805c.png] 

And, 

 
• 'HAZE' is coded as ‘68’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/238d3b300bb6bfb7c9d08d9fc0add0220fc9f5bddf70ceb6bd919b354a4d9778.png] 

Similarly,

 
• 'GOAT' is coded as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c00846af85554a3263d03e3f9d056a0052bbedf3c93b4c7bb42010c8a65a7121.png] 

Hence, "65" is the correct answer.
